public interface APIParam
Contract for types usable as a query/path parameter value — the type constraint on the SDK's parameter-building helpers (ParameterMapper/ModelUtils), so arbitrary objects cannot end up on a request URI.

paramValue() is the single wire form for parameters. It defaults to toString() — for a plain enum that is name(), which is the wire code for most SDK enums; enums whose wire code differs from the constant name override toString() (or this method directly), and value types like Sortable render their own form (e.g. "-propertyName" for a descending sort).

Invariant (enforced by ApiParamContractTest): when an implementing enum also declares a Jackson @JsonValue accessor for request/response bodies, paramValue() must return the same string — one wire form per value, whether it travels in a body or a query parameter.
